map.何时 τ 取最大值？: When does τ reach its maximum?
map.θ=90°（线圈平面平行磁场）时 sinθ=1，τ=N·I·A·B；θ=0 或: At θ = 90° (coil plane parallel to field) sinθ = 1, τ = N·I·A·B; at θ = 0° or 180° τ = 0.
map.电机启动转矩怎么算？: How is motor starting torque calculated?
map.τ=N·I·A·B·sinθ，I 越大转矩越大；启动电流大故启动转矩大。本工具为: τ = N·I·A·B·sinθ; larger I gives larger torque, so high starting current yields high starting torque.
